proof_methods.justification: Every OpenAI byte-level BPE tokenizer encodes UTF-8 byte sequences by merging single-byte base tokens (so token_count <= utf8_byte_count + small fixed message/schema framing overhead). Across all 63 frozen C2 requests (3 canary + 60 comparative), the maximum total serialized provider_wire_request JSON size is 89,435 UTF-8 bytes (and maximum combined system_prompt + user_prompt + response_format JSON schema is 79,332 UTF-8 bytes on fixture W06-DEV-SELECT-032). Even under the theoretical worst-case 1-token-per-UTF-8-byte bound, input tokens cannot exceed ~90,000 tokens, which is <33.1% of the 272,000 input-token threshold (at least 182,565 tokens below 272,000).

Authoritative gpt-6.1-sol usage metadata under locked prompt P1 and portable_schema_v2 exists for all three frozen DEV destinations (ha-noi, ha-long, da-nang). Even on the largest catalog (da-nang, ~74.5 KB user prompt), provider-reported prompt_tokens is 29,631..29,633 tokens (10.89% of the 272,000 threshold).

rate_limit_analysis.counterfactual_firewall: A fixed 2,000ms inter-call delay bounds client-issued request cadence only; it does NOT guarantee that provider-side HTTP 429 (rate-limit/quota) or HTTP 503/5xx (overload) errors will not occur.

defensible_client_cadence_bounds.empirical_latency_inclusive_cadence_note: Because the runner executes calls strictly sequentially (concurrency = 1) and waits 2,000ms between completion of call N and dispatch of call N+1, a typical completed generation taking ~20s-60s results in ~1 to 2.7 requests/minute total across the harness (and <1.5 RPM per provider).

ANTHROPIC.authority_note: Official Anthropic Claude API documentation defines rate limits across RPM, ITPM (input tokens/min), and OTPM (output tokens/min) across Tiers 1-4 plus monthly spend limits. Actual account limits and credit balance remain Project Owner evidence.

GOOGLE.authority_note: Official Google Gemini API documentation states that rate limits are applied per project across RPM, TPM (input), and RPD, vary by model and project usage tier (Free, Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3), and active limits for a specific project must be checked in Google AI Studio. Generic public table examples must not be substituted for actual project limits.

OPENAI.authority_note: Official OpenAI documentation defines rate limits across RPM, RPD, TPM, and TPD by organization/project usage tier (Tier 1 through Tier 5) and monthly spend limit. Actual account limits remain Project Owner evidence.
